How we handle the numbers.

We don't play games with bids. When customers compare quotes, we tell them the truth:

"Our number reflects our operating costs and that we have to turn a profit in order to stay in business."

We can provide a full breakdown on request. Our margin is at 30% gross, which means we operate at under 15% net. We own heavy equipment, we pay our team fairly, and we don't cut corners on materials.
